subject: DI03005011

body.en:
Definition / principle

Dynamic viscosity relates shear stress to shear rate for a Newtonian fluid. Specific gravity is the ratio of liquid density to a declared reference-water density. Relative humidity compares water-vapour partial pressure with saturation pressure at the same temperature. Volume flow is volume crossing a section per time.

Detailed explanation and conditions

Use Pa s for dynamic viscosity and m²/s for kinematic viscosity. SG and relative humidity are dimensionless ratios; RH is often expressed as%.Record temperature because viscosity, density and saturation pressure depend on it. Flow meters must match phase, range, pressure drop and installation requirements.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Newtonian fluid માં shear stress/shear rate નો સંબંધ Dynamic Viscosity આપે છે. Liquid density ને declared reference-water density થી ભાગતાં Specific Gravity મળે છે. Same temperature પર vapour partial pressure/saturation pressure નો ratio Relative Humidity છે. Section પાર થતા volume/time ને Volume Flow કહીએ.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા Conditions

Dynamic viscosity નો એકમ Pa s તથા kinematic નો m²/s છે. SG તથા RH dimensionless ratios છે; RH ઘણીવાર%માં છે. Temperature નોંધો કારણ કે viscosity, density તથા saturation pressure તેના પર આધારિત છે. Flow meter phase, range, pressure drop તથા installation પ્રમાણે લો.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

A viscometer deriving viscosity from laminar flow through a calibrated narrow tube.

Principle

For a Newtonian fluid in fully developed laminar circular-tube flow, flow depends inversely on viscosity at a specified pressure drop.

Construction

The pressure-flow form shown has a straight capillary of known length and radius, an inlet pressure reservoir and an outlet/reference pressure. A measured volume and timing arrangement determine flow; temperature control maintains a defined sample temperature. Pressure tappings must define the actual capillary pressure drop. The bore must be clean and the geometry calibrated. Other gravity-timing capillary designs use their own instrument constant.

Working

Establish a steady, small, known pressure difference and allow the sample to reach the specified temperature. Collect a known volume over measured time to obtain Q. Use the capillary geometry and pressure drop in the laminar relation to calculate viscosity. Verify laminar conditions and account for entrance, end and hydrostatic corrections where necessary. A calibrated gravity-timing relation may instead give kinematic viscosity; do not confuse it with dynamic viscosity without multiplying by density.

Applications

Low-to-moderate viscosity Newtonian liquids with suitable capillary dimensions.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Sensitive to radius, temperature, bubbles and deposits. Non-Newtonian apparent viscosity depends on the measurement shear condition.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Calibrated narrow tube માં laminar flow પરથી viscosity માપતું viscometer છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Newtonian fully developed laminar circular flow માં specified pressure drop પર flow viscosity ને inverse proportional છે.

રચના (Construction)

Drawing ના pressure-flow form માં known length/radius capillary, inlet pressure reservoir તથા outlet reference છે. Measured volume/time પરથી flow મળે છે. Temperature control sample temperature fixed રાખે છે. Pressure taps actual capillary drop માટે હોવા જોઈએ. Bore clean તથા geometry calibrated જોઈએ. Other gravity-timing capillaries પોતાની instrument constant વાપરે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Sample ને specified temperature પર રાખીને steady known pressure difference બનાવો. Known volume તથા time પરથી Q મેળવો. Geometry તથા pressure drop ને laminar relation માં મૂકી viscosity કાઢો. Laminar condition તથા required entrance/end/hydrostatic corrections તપાસો. Calibrated gravity-timing relation kinematic viscosity આપી શકે છે. Dynamic viscosity માટે density થી ગુણવું પડે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Suitable geometry સાથે low-to-moderate viscosity Newtonian liquids.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Radius, temperature, bubbles તથા deposits નો મોટો અસર છે. Non-Newtonian apparent viscosity shear condition પર આધારિત છે.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

A rotational viscometer measuring viscous drag between concentric cylinders.

Principle

At fixed geometry and angular speed, Newtonian viscous torque is proportional to viscosity.

Construction

A cylindrical bob is concentric with a cup containing the sample. In the illustrated arrangement, a motor rotates the outer cup at known angular speed while the inner bob is held through a torque-sensing support. A temperature-controlled jacket, known immersion length and defined annular gap establish the measuring geometry. The alternative rotating-bob arrangement is also used but requires its own geometry/calibration.

Working

Rotate the cup steadily so the sample shears in the annular gap. Viscous drag exerts torque on the stationary bob; the sensor measures the resisting torque. After calibration and end-effect correction, the measured torque at the known speed yields viscosity. For non-Newtonian samples report apparent viscosity together with speed or the appropriate shear-rate definition rather than one speed-independent material constant.

Applications

Liquid viscosity and rheological comparison over selected speed and temperature ranges.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Concentricity, gap, immersion, temperature, end effects and inertial/turbulent flow can change the result.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Concentric cylinders વચ્ચે viscous drag માપતું rotational viscometer છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Fixed geometry/angular speed પર Newtonian viscous torque viscosity ને proportional છે.

રચના (Construction)

Cylindrical bob sample cup સાથે concentric છે. Drawing માં motor outer cup ને known angular speed પર ફેરવે છે અને inner bob torque-sensing support થી held છે. Temperature jacket, known immersion length તથા annular gap geometry નક્કી કરે છે. Rotating-bob alternative પણ છે, પણ તેની પોતાની calibration જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Cup steadily rotate થતાં annular gap માં sample shear થાય છે. Viscous drag stationary bob પર torque આપે છે. Sensor resisting torque માપે છે. Calibration/end-effect correction પછી known speed પર torque પરથી viscosity મળે છે. Non-Newtonian sample માટે speed/યોગ્ય shear rate સાથે apparent viscosity report કરો; એક speed-independent constant ન માનો.

ઉપયોગો

Selected speed/temperature ranges માં liquid viscosity તથા rheological comparison.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Concentricity, gap, immersion, temperature, end effects તથા inertial/turbulent flow result બદલે છે.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

A viscometer using the twist of a calibrated torsion wire/spring to measure viscous resisting torque.

Principle

At a known relative rotation rate, viscous drag twists the suspension until restoring torque balances drag.

Construction

In the illustrated steady-torque form, a sample cup rotates at a controlled speed around a suspended bob. A calibrated torsion wire or spring supports the bob from a fixed head, and an angular pointer/pickup measures twist. Temperature, immersion length and gap are defined. The rotating-cylinder name describes the geometry; torsion describes torque detection, so the two classifications can overlap.

Working

Start the cup at the specified speed after temperature equilibration. Liquid drag tends to rotate the bob and twists the suspension. The bob settles at a deflection where calibrated restoring torque equals drag. Read the angular twist and use the validated geometry/speed calibration to obtain viscosity. For a Newtonian liquid at fixed geometry, torque is proportional to viscosity and speed. A non-Newtonian result must include its measuring condition; one angle is not universally a viscosity value.

Applications

Controlled-temperature viscosity measurement using a calibrated torsional torque mechanism.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Alignment, wire calibration, zero, temperature, end effects and speed matter. Do not confuse steady angular twist with oscillation damping; the alternative shown below has a different model.

Governing relation / symbols

Alternative: torsional-oscillation form

A different torsion variant suspends an immersed element, displaces it through a small angle and releases it without continuous cup rotation. Record oscillation period/amplitude decay and infer viscosity using a validated model including geometry, density and fluid-added inertia. This is not the steady-torque calibration.[1]

Reference: [1] Torsion-pendulum viscosity method.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Calibrated torsion wire/spring ના twist વડે viscous resisting torque માપતું viscometer છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Known relative rotation rate પર viscous drag suspension twist કરે છે. Restoring torque drag ને balance કરે ત્યારે equilibrium બને છે.

રચના (Construction)

Drawing ના steady-torque form માં controlled-speed sample cup suspended bob આસપાસ rotate થાય છે. Fixed head ના calibrated torsion wire/spring થી bob held છે. Angular pointer/pickup twist માપે છે. Temperature, immersion તથા gap defined છે. Rotating-cylinder geometry છે અને torsion torque-detection principle છે; બંને classes overlap થઈ શકે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Temperature equilibration પછી cup ને specified speed પર ફેરવો. Liquid drag bob ને rotate કરવાનો પ્રયત્ન કરીને suspension twist કરે છે. Calibrated restoring torque તથા drag સમાન થાય ત્યાં bob deflection settle થાય છે. Angular twist ને validated geometry/speed calibration વડે viscosity માં ફેરવો. Newtonian fixed geometry પર torque viscosity તથા speed ને proportional છે. Non-Newtonian result સાથે measuring condition આપો; એક angle universal viscosity value નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Calibrated torsional torque mechanism વડે controlled-temperature viscosity measurement.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Alignment, wire calibration, zero, temperature, end effects તથા speed મહત્વનાં છે. Steady twist ને oscillation damping સાથે ન ભેળવો. નીચેના alternative નું model જુદું છે.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

Alternative: Torsional-oscillation Form

બીજા torsion variant માં immersed suspended element ને નાના angle થી displace કરીને continuous cup rotation વગર release કરો. Oscillation period/amplitude decay ને geometry, density તથા fluid-added inertia ધરાવતા validated model વડે viscosity માં ફેરવો. આ steady-torque calibration નથી.[1]

Reference: [1] Torsion-pendulum viscosity method.

body.en:
Definition

A floating instrument indicating liquid density or specific gravity by immersion depth.

Principle

At equilibrium, weight equals the weight of displaced liquid.

Construction

A sealed glass or compatible body has a weighted lower bulb for upright stability and a narrow graduated stem. A tall sample cylinder provides sufficient depth and clearance. A scale is calibrated for density or SG at declared reference temperatures. The instrument must float freely without touching the wall or bottom; the surface must be free of adhering bubbles.

Working

Lower the clean hydrometer gently into the temperature-equilibrated sample. In a denser liquid less displaced volume supports the same weight, so it floats higher; in a less dense liquid it sinks deeper. Read the specified meniscus against the stem and apply the instrument’s temperature correction when required. The scale generally increases in density toward the bulb because a higher-density liquid cuts the stem lower relative to the body.

Applications

Liquid density/SG checks where a safe representative sample is available.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Surface tension, bubbles, viscosity, temperature and incorrect meniscus reading cause error. SG requires declared liquid/reference-water temperatures.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Immersion depth વડે liquid density/specific gravity બતાવતું floating instrument છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Equilibrium પર instrument weight તથા displaced liquid weight સમાન છે.

રચના (Construction)

Sealed body ના lower bulb માં weight હોવાથી તે upright રહે છે. Narrow graduated stem તથા tall sample cylinder હોય છે. Scale density અથવા stated reference temperatures ના SG માટે calibrated છે. Instrument wall/bottom ને અડ્યા વગર freely float થવું જોઈએ. Adhering bubbles ન હોવા જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Clean hydrometer ને temperature-equilibrated sample માં gently મૂકો. Dense liquid માં ઓછા displaced volume થી same weight support થાય છે એટલે hydrometer ઊંચો floats કરે છે. O છી density માં વધુ ઊંડો જાય છે. Specified meniscus વાંચી જરૂરી temperature correction લો. Higher-density liquid stem ને bulb ની નજીક cut કરતું હોવાથી density scale સામાન્ય રીતે bulb તરફ વધે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Safe representative sample હોય ત્યાં liquid density/SG checks.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Surface tension, bubbles, viscosity, temperature તથા wrong meniscus થી error થાય છે. SG માટે liquid/reference-water temperatures જોઈએ.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

A mechanical relative-humidity instrument using the hygroscopic length change of treated hair.

Principle

Hair absorbs/desorbs moisture and changes length with relative humidity under controlled/calibrated conditions.

Construction

Cleaned/treated hair strands are held under light tension between a fixed support and a spring/lever mechanism. The lever drives a pointer on an RH-calibrated dial. A ventilated protective housing admits representative air while shielding the delicate element. Tension must keep the hair straight without restraining its small humidity-related length change.

Working

Exposure to more humid air increases hair moisture and normally increases length. The spring follows the change and the lever amplifies it into pointer motion. Drier air reverses the movement. After sufficient equilibration the reading is compared with the RH scale. The response can exhibit hysteresis and aging, so periodic comparison with a suitable humidity reference is needed. It measures RH, not directly kg water per kg dry air.

Applications

Simple ambient/process-area RH indication where its accuracy and exposure limits are adequate.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Slow response, contamination, condensation, temperature effects and aging limit accuracy. Do not wet/clean the hair by an unapproved method.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Treated hair ની hygroscopic length change વડે relative humidity માપતું mechanical instrument છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Hair moisture absorb/desorb કરીને calibrated conditions પર RH પ્રમાણે length બદલે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Cleaned/treated hair strands fixed support તથા spring/lever વચ્ચે light tension હેઠળ હોય છે. Lever RH-calibrated dial pointer ચલાવે છે. Ventilated housing representative air અંદર આવવા દે છે અને element protect કરે છે. Tension hair ને સીધું રાખે, પણ length change રોકતું ન હોવું જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Humid air માં hair moisture તથા સામાન્ય રીતે length વધે છે. Spring/lever change ને pointer motion માં amplify કરે છે. Dry air માં reverse movement થાય છે. Equilibration પછી RH scale વાંચો. Hysteresis/aging હોવાથી suitable humidity reference સામે periodic comparison જોઈએ. આ RH માપે છે, kg water/kg dry air સીધું નહીં.

ઉપયોગો

Accuracy/exposure limits યોગ્ય હોય ત્યાં simple ambient/process-area RH indication.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Slow response, contamination, condensation, temperature તથા aging limitations છે. Unapproved method થી hair wet/clean ન કરો.

body.en:
Definition

A flow meter measuring the drag force on a target placed in the flowing stream.

Principle

Under calibrated conditions, target drag is related approximately to density times velocity squared.

Construction

A disc or target is held normal to flow inside a pipe by a support rod. A force/strain-sensing element receives rod force through a sealed or isolated connection. A transmitter conditions the signal and the pipe/target geometry is fixed by calibration. The illustration shows the target face normal to the indicated flow and the rod leading to the force pickup.

Working

Flow exerts drag on the target and loads the support rod. The sensing system measures force and the calibrated electronics infers velocity or volume flow using the proper density and target coefficient. At similar coefficient and density, Q varies roughly with the square root of force. Zero-flow mechanical preload and changing fluid density must be handled by the instrument model; force alone is not universally a linear volume-flow signal.

Applications

Suitable liquids, gases and some difficult services according to the target design.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Obstruction adds pressure loss; coating, erosion, vibration, density and flow profile affect calibration.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Flowing stream માં મૂકેલા target પર drag force માપતું flow meter છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Calibrated conditions પર target drag આશરે density×velocity squared પ્રમાણે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Pipe ની અંદર disc/target flow ને normal support rod થી held છે. Sealed/isolated connection મારફતે force/strain sensor rod force મેળવે છે. Transmitter signal condition કરે છે. Pipe/target geometry calibration થી fixed છે. Drawing માં target flow સામે normal તથા rod force pickup સુધી બતાવ્યો છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Flow target પર drag આપે છે અને rod load થાય છે. Sensor force માપે છે. Electronics proper density/target coefficient થી velocity અથવા volume flow આપે છે. Similar coefficient/density પર Q આશરે force ના square root પ્રમાણે છે. Zero-flow preload તથા changing density નું correction model પ્રમાણે જોઈએ. Force universal linear Qsignal નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Target design મુજબ suitable liquids, gases તથા selected difficult services.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Obstruction થી pressure loss થાય છે. Coating, erosion, vibration, density તથા profile calibration બદલે છે.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

A flow meter inferring velocity from the frequency of vortices shed by a bluff body.

Principle

Within its calibrated Reynolds-number range, the shedding frequency follows f=St·v/d.

Construction

A fixed bluff body spans the pipe and produces alternating vortices downstream. A pressure, strain or other suitable detector senses the periodic disturbance; electronics extracts frequency and applies the meter calibration. The body dimension and pipe bore define the geometry. The diagram marks staggered vortices on alternate sides, not a rotating turbine. The syllabus “shredding” is the usual vortex-shedding method.

Working

Fluid passing the body separates alternately from its sides. The repeating wake produces sensor pulses whose frequency rises approximately with mean velocity over the specified operating range. Volume flow is obtained from velocity and pipe area or a calibrated meter factor. Low velocity or unsuitable Reynolds number may not produce a usable signal. Gas/steam mass flow additionally needs appropriate density information; frequency alone does not provide universal mass flow.

Applications

Suitable single-phase liquids, gases and steam in the meter’s rated operating envelope.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Needs proper straight runs, flow conditioning and vibration control. Wet steam, two-phase flow, coating and out-of-range Reynolds number can invalidate readings.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Bluff body પાછળ shed થતા vortices ની frequency પરથી velocity માપતું flow meter છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Calibrated Reynolds-number range માં shedding frequency f=St·v/d અનુસરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Fixed bluff body pipe માં હોય છે અને downstream alternating vortices બનાવે છે. Pressure/strain અથવા suitable detector periodic disturbance sense કરે છે. Electronics frequency પરથી calibration લાગુ કરે છે. Body dimension તથા pipe bore geometry નક્કી કરે છે. Drawing staggered vortices બતાવે છે, turbine નહીં. Syllabus નું “shredding” standard vortex-shedding method છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Body ની sides પરથી fluid alternately separate થાય છે. Wake ના pulses ની frequency operating range માં mean velocity સાથે વધે છે. Velocity×pipe area અથવા meter factor થી volume flow મળે છે. Low velocity/unsuitable Reynolds પર usable signal ન મળે. Gas/steam mass flow માટે density જોઈએ; frequency એકલું universal mass flow આપતું નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Rated envelope માં suitable single-phase liquids, gases તથા steam.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Proper straight runs, flow conditioning તથા vibration control જોઈએ. Wet steam, two-phase flow, coating તથા out-of-range Reynolds reading બગાડે છે.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

A flow meter using fluid-driven rotor speed to infer volume flow.

Principle

Within the calibrated range, rotor blade-passage pulse frequency is proportional to volume flow.

Construction

An axial bladed rotor is supported by a shaft, bearings and flow-straightening supports inside the meter tube. A magnetic/inductive or other pickup senses blade passages through the housing and sends pulses to a counter/transmitter. The selected rotor, clearances and bearing materials must suit fluid cleanliness, lubricity, pressure and temperature.

Working

Fluid torque rotates the blades while bearing/friction drag resists them. At steady flow, the calibrated rotor speed corresponds to volume flow. The pickup produces pulses, possibly several per revolution depending on blade/pickup design, and electronics converts frequency through a calibrated Kfactor. Totalized pulse count can determine volume. Do not equate each pulse with one full rotor revolution unless the particular meter specifies that relation.

Applications

Clean, compatible fluids and volume totalization/custody applications only where the specified calibration/approval applies.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Moving parts wear; debris, swirl, viscosity changes, bearing drag and low-flow thresholds affect calibration.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Fluid-driven rotor speed પરથી volume flow નક્કી કરતું flow meter છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Calibrated range માં blade-passage pulse frequency volume flow ને proportional છે.

રચના (Construction)

Axial bladed rotor shaft, bearings તથા flow-straightening supports પર meter tube માં held છે. Magnetic/inductive pickup housing બહારથી blade passages sense કરીને pulses counter/transmitter સુધી મોકલે છે. Rotor, clearances તથા bearing materials fluid cleanliness, lubricity, pressure/temperature પ્રમાણે જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Fluid torque blades ફેરવે છે અને bearing/friction resistance આપે છે. Steady flow પર calibrated speed volume flow દર્શાવે છે. Design પ્રમાણે એક revolution માં ઘણા pulses હોઈ શકે છે. Electronics calibrated Kfactor વડે frequency ને Q માં ફેરવે છે. Total pulse count પરથી volume મળે છે. દરેક pulse ને એક revolution સમાન ન માનો.

ઉપયોગો

Clean compatible fluids તથા specified calibration/approval હોય ત્યાં volume totalization/custody applications.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Moving parts wear થાય છે. Debris, swirl, viscosity, bearing drag તથા low-flow threshold calibration બદલે છે.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

q.en: State the definition and principle of Viscosity,specific gravity,humidity and flow.
q.gu: Viscosity,Specific Gravity,Humidity તથા Flow ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Dynamic viscosity relates shear stress to shear rate for a Newtonian fluid. Specific gravity is the ratio of liquid density to a declared reference-water density. Relative humidity compares water-vapour partial pressure with saturation pressure at the same temperature. Volume flow is volume crossing a section per time.
a.gu: Newtonian fluid માં shear stress/shear rate નો સંબંધ Dynamic Viscosity આપે છે. Liquid density ને declared reference-water density થી ભાગતાં Specific Gravity મળે છે. Same temperature પર vapour partial pressure/saturation pressure નો ratio Relative Humidity છે. Section પાર થતા volume/time ને Volume Flow કહીએ.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Capillary-tube viscometer.
q.gu: Capillary-tube Viscometer ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A viscometer deriving viscosity from laminar flow through a calibrated narrow tube. For a Newtonian fluid in fully developed laminar circular-tube flow, flow depends inversely on viscosity at a specified pressure drop.
a.gu: Calibrated narrow tube માં laminar flow પરથી viscosity માપતું viscometer છે. Newtonian fully developed laminar circular flow માં specified pressure drop પર flow viscosity ને inverse proportional છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Rotating-cylinder viscometer.
q.gu: Rotating-cylinder Viscometer ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A rotational viscometer measuring viscous drag between concentric cylinders. At fixed geometry and angular speed, Newtonian viscous torque is proportional to viscosity.
a.gu: Concentric cylinders વચ્ચે viscous drag માપતું rotational viscometer છે. Fixed geometry/angular speed પર Newtonian viscous torque viscosity ને proportional છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Torsion viscometer—steady-torque form.
q.gu: Torsion Viscometer—Steady-torque Form ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A viscometer using the twist of a calibrated torsion wire/spring to measure viscous resisting torque. At a known relative rotation rate, viscous drag twists the suspension until restoring torque balances drag.
a.gu: Calibrated torsion wire/spring ના twist વડે viscous resisting torque માપતું viscometer છે. Known relative rotation rate પર viscous drag suspension twist કરે છે. Restoring torque drag ને balance કરે ત્યારે equilibrium બને છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Hydrometer.
q.gu: Hydrometer ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A floating instrument indicating liquid density or specific gravity by immersion depth. At equilibrium, weight equals the weight of displaced liquid.
a.gu: Immersion depth વડે liquid density/specific gravity બતાવતું floating instrument છે. Equilibrium પર instrument weight તથા displaced liquid weight સમાન છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Hair hygrometer.
q.gu: Hair Hygrometer ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A mechanical relative-humidity instrument using the hygroscopic length change of treated hair. Hair absorbs/desorbs moisture and changes length with relative humidity under controlled/calibrated conditions.
a.gu: Treated hair ની hygroscopic length change વડે relative humidity માપતું mechanical instrument છે. Hair moisture absorb/desorb કરીને calibrated conditions પર RH પ્રમાણે length બદલે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Target flow meter.
q.gu: Target Flow Meter ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A flow meter measuring the drag force on a target placed in the flowing stream. Under calibrated conditions, target drag is related approximately to density times velocity squared.
a.gu: Flowing stream માં મૂકેલા target પર drag force માપતું flow meter છે. Calibrated conditions પર target drag આશરે density×velocity squared પ્રમાણે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Vortex-shedding flow meter.
q.gu: Vortex-shedding Flow Meter ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A flow meter inferring velocity from the frequency of vortices shed by a bluff body. Within its calibrated Reynolds-number range, the shedding frequency follows f=St·v/d.
a.gu: Bluff body પાછળ shed થતા vortices ની frequency પરથી velocity માપતું flow meter છે. Calibrated Reynolds-number range માં shedding frequency f=St·v/d અનુસરે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Turbine flow meter.
q.gu: Turbine Flow Meter ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A flow meter using fluid-driven rotor speed to infer volume flow. Within the calibrated range, rotor blade-passage pulse frequency is proportional to volume flow.
a.gu: Fluid-driven rotor speed પરથી volume flow નક્કી કરતું flow meter છે. Calibrated range માં blade-passage pulse frequency volume flow ને proportional છે.
